name: Sudden Steel: [Class Bonus] Efficiency
notes: Sudden Steel's only ability is [Class Bonus] Efficiency (reduce reserve cost by champion's current level). Champion CardID-patched directly to Lorraine, Blademaster (WARRIOR, level 2), reducing the printed 6 reserve cost to 4. Played into myIntent via FSM (ATTACK cards don't go through the fast-action opportunity flow until after the attack is declared, per wind-cutter-class-bonus-power-attack), then attacks the opponent's champion directly.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] Efficiency (This card costs 1 less to activate for each level your champion has.)
